dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: Ah, let's try one more time... Kutta, listen to me! Sit!

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: Remember what a Sumpter Beast is? A large, rotund creature.

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: And do you remember how many Sumpter Beasts we have?

dialogues.speaker: Kutta
dialogues.text: Woof, woof, woof, woof, woof... woof?

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: Wrong again! I told you to include the cubs that were born last month.

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: It's no use wagging your tail at me! Wrong answers will get you no treats.

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: ...Okay, okay, at least there's been an improvement since the last time. I'll give you a little.

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: I envy you sometimes. Your only job every day is running around the Sumpter Beasts. Life is so easy for you...

dialogues.speaker: Salm
dialogues.text: Unlike mine. I work day and night to keep these Sumpter Beasts, and whatever profit I manage to make barely covers the loss from those that run away.
